words_to_learn.definition_vi: bận rộn, náo nhiệt, đông đúc

examples.en: Alfred was busy getting ready for his vacation.
examples.vi: Alfred đang bận rộn chuẩn bị cho kỳ nghỉ của mình.

examples.en: The airport was busy, with people catching planes and heading for car rental companies.
examples.vi: Sân bay rất đông đúc, với dòng người đang bắt máy bay và hướng tới các công ty cho thuê xe.

structures: busy with something (bận rộn với cái gì)
busy doing something (bận rộn làm việc gì)
usage.tip: Cấu trúc: 'be busy with N' hoặc 'be busy + V-ing' ('He was busy packing his suitcase').

extra_families.example: The front desk clerks were busily typing reservation details into the computer.
The car rental business experiences high demand during the summer holidays.

srs_sentence.en: The car rental counter was exceptionally _____ on Friday evening as weekend travelers arrived.
srs_sentence.vi: Quầy cho thuê xe đặc biệt bận rộn vào tối thứ Sáu khi những du khách cuối tuần đến nơi.

words_to_learn.definition_en: to happen at the same time
words_to_learn.definition_vi: trùng hợp, diễn ra cùng lúc

examples.en: My cousin's wedding coincided with a holiday weekend, so it was a perfect time to rent a car and go for a drive.
examples.vi: Đám cưới của em họ tôi trùng vào một kỳ nghỉ cuối tuần, vì vậy đó là thời điểm hoàn hảo để thuê một chiếc xe và đi dạo.

examples.en: Sean was hoping that the days for the special discount on car rentals would coincide with his vacation, but they did not.
examples.vi: Sean hy vọng rằng những ngày áp dụng giảm giá đặc biệt cho thuê xe sẽ trùng với kỳ nghỉ của anh ấy, nhưng không phải vậy.

word_family.example: This year, my vacation coincides with a national holiday, which will make renting a car more expensive.
By coincidence, I ran into an old friend in line waiting to rent a car.
Coincidentally, we are offering a special discount if you are over age 65.

structures: coincide with something (trùng với cái gì)
usage.tip: Động từ 'coincide' hầu như luôn đi kèm giới từ 'with' ('The conference coincides with the festival').

extra_families.example: By remarkable coincidence, we booked rooms at the exact same seaside hotel.
Any similarity between the travel brochures was purely coincidental.

srs_sentence.en: The timing of our business trip _____ with the city's annual international trade fair.
srs_sentence.vi: Thời gian chuyến công tác của chúng tôi đã trùng với hội chợ thương mại quốc tế thường niên của thành phố.

words_to_learn.definition_en: a lack of clarity, order, or understanding
words_to_learn.definition_vi: sự lộn xộn, sự nhầm lẫn, bối rối

examples.en: There was some confusion about which rental discount coupons applied to which car rental agency.
examples.vi: Đã có một sự nhầm lẫn về việc phiếu giảm giá áp dụng cho đại lý cho thuê xe nào.

examples.en: To avoid any confusion about renting the car, Yolanda asked her travel agent to make the arrangements on her behalf.
examples.vi: Để tránh bất kỳ sự nhầm lẫn nào về việc thuê xe, Yolanda đã yêu cầu đại lý du lịch sắp xếp thay cho mình.

word_family.example: These long car rental contracts always confuse me.
The crowds at the car rental office resulted in a lot of confusion.
Driving in an unfamiliar city can be quite confusing.

structures: confusion about/over something (sự nhầm lẫn về cái gì)
to avoid confusion (để tránh nhầm lẫn)
usage.tip: Cụm 'to avoid confusion' (để tránh nhầm lẫn) là cụm mục đích rất hay gặp trong các thư thông báo.

extra_families.example: The complex floor plan of the rental agency confused many arriving passengers.
The highway road signs near the airport exit were very confusing to foreign drivers.

srs_sentence.en: Clear directional signs were installed in the parking lot to prevent _____ among arriving motorists.
srs_sentence.vi: Các biển chỉ dẫn rõ ràng đã được lắp đặt trong bãi đỗ xe để ngăn ngừa sự bối rối, nhầm lẫn cho những người lái xe khi đến.

words_to_learn.definition_vi: liên hệ, liên lạc; người liên hệ

examples.en: Manuel contacted at least a dozen car rental agencies to get the best deal.
examples.vi: Manuel đã liên hệ với ít nhất một tá công ty cho thuê xe để có được thỏa thuận tốt nhất.

examples.en: Last night I was contacted by my travel agent who said he had found a better price on a car rental.
examples.vi: Tối qua tôi đã được liên hệ bởi đại lý du lịch của mình, người nói rằng anh ấy đã tìm thấy một mức giá tốt hơn cho việc thuê xe.

structures: contact somebody directly (liên hệ trực tiếp với ai)
make contact with (tạo liên lạc với)
usage.tip: Khi là ngoại động từ, 'contact' KHÔNG đi với 'with' ('Please contact me', KHÔNG nói 'contact with me'). Khi là danh từ thì đi với 'with' ('in contact with').

extra_families.example: The rental manager is contactable by mobile phone twenty-four hours a day.

srs_sentence.en: If you experience any vehicle breakdown during your rental period, please _____ roadside assistance immediately.
srs_sentence.vi: Nếu bạn gặp phải bất kỳ sự cố hỏng xe nào trong thời gian thuê, vui lòng liên hệ ngay với dịch vụ cứu hộ ven đường.

words_to_learn.definition_en: to fail to satisfy the hope, desire, or expectation of
words_to_learn.definition_vi: làm thất vọng, không đáp ứng được mong đợi

examples.en: Leila was disappointed to discover that no rental cars were available the weekend she wished to travel.
examples.vi: Leila đã rất thất vọng khi phát hiện ra không có xe thuê nào còn trống vào cuối tuần cô ấy muốn đi du lịch.

examples.en: I hate to disappoint you, but I can't allow you to rent a car unless you have a major credit card.
examples.vi: Tôi ghét phải làm bạn thất vọng, nhưng tôi không thể cho phép bạn thuê xe trừ khi bạn có thẻ tín dụng quốc tế.

word_family.example: The service at that car rental agency always disappoints me, so next time I plan to use a different agency.

structures: disappoint somebody (làm ai thất vọng)
be disappointed with/in/by something (thất vọng vì điều gì)
usage.tip: Cấu trúc cảm xúc: 'be disappointed WITH/ABOUT something' (người cảm thấy thất vọng) và 'disappointing' (sự việc gây thất vọng: 'a disappointing result').

extra_families.example: To our disappointment, the car model we had requested was already sold out.
The travelers were disappointed by the poor cleanliness of the rental vehicle.
The lack of available compact vehicles resulted in a disappointing customer experience.

srs_sentence.en: We were deeply _____ to learn that all the convertibles had already been reserved for the weekend.
srs_sentence.vi: Chúng tôi đã vô cùng thất vọng khi biết rằng tất cả các xe mui trần đều đã được đặt hết cho dịp cuối tuần.

examples.en: I never intended to drive to Los Angeles until my brother suggested we do it together.
examples.vi: Tôi chưa bao giờ có ý định lái xe đến Los Angeles cho đến khi anh trai tôi đề nghị chúng tôi làm điều đó cùng nhau.

examples.en: Do you intend to return the car to this location or to another location?

word_family.example: I have every intention of paying by cash even though I reserved the car with my credit card.

structures: intend to do something (dự định làm gì)
be intended for somebody (được thiết kế/dành cho ai)
usage.tip: Cấu trúc: 'intend to + V' (dự định làm gì) hoặc 'be intended for + N' (dành riêng cho ai/mục đích gì).

extra_families.example: It is our clear intention to expand our car rental fleet by thirty percent next year.

srs_sentence.en: Drivers who _____ to travel across international borders must notify the rental office beforehand.
srs_sentence.vi: Những tài xế có ý định lái xe qua biên giới quốc tế phải thông báo cho văn phòng cho thuê trước.

part7.text: Part 7 Reading Comprehension Questions 19–23 refer to the following article. Will your next trip involve a rental car? With a little careful planning, you can prevent some common headaches. If your travel plans coincide with a holiday, you need to plan well ahead of time. Car rental agencies are very busy at such times, and you won't be guaranteed a car unless you make your reservation well in advance. Contact the car rental agency and specify the kind of car you want and the dates you will need it. It's a good idea to call the agency again shortly before you begin your trip to confirm your reservation. This is the best way to avoid disappointment. Another common problem that car renters face is extra charges. Some agencies add charges for options without letting the renter know about them. Sometimes renters aren't aware of this until they receive their credit card bill. Read the contract carefully before you sign it to make sure that you are paying only for what you requested. And don't be tempted to pay for things you don't need. It might be fun to drive a large, luxury car, but if you are traveling alone and are on a budget, it probably isn't worth paying for such a car.

_raw.words_to_learn:
Study the following definitions and examples.

1. busy adj., engaged in activity

a. Alfred was busy getting ready for his vacation.

b. The airport was busy, with people catching planes and heading for car rental companies.

2. coincide v., to happen at the same time a. My cousin's wedding coincided with a holiday weekend, so it was a perfect time to rent a car and go for a drive.

b. Sean was hoping that the days for the special discount on car rentals would coincide with his vacation, but they did not.

3. confusion n., a lack of clarity, order, or understanding a. There was some confusion about which rental discount coupons applied to which car rental agency.

b. To avoid any confusion about renting the car, Yolanda asked her travel agent to make the arrangements on her behalf.

4. contact v., to get in touch with

a. Manuel contacted at least a dozen car rental agencies to get the best deal.

b. Last night I was contacted by my travel agent who said he had found a better price on a car rental.

5. disappoint v., to fail to satisfy the hope, desire, or expectation of a. Leila was disappointed to discover that no rental cars were available the weekend she wished to travel.

b. I hate to disappoint you, but I can't allow you to rent a car unless you have a major credit card.

6. intend v., to have in mind

a. I never intended to drive to Los Angeles until my brother suggested we do it together.

b. Do you intend to return the car to this location or to another location?

7. license n., the legal permission to do or own a specified thing

a. First, I'll need to see your driver's license and a major credit card.

b. You will need a license in order to run this business.

8. nervously adv., in a distressed or uneasy manner a. As we approached the city Lonnie started driving nervously, so I volunteered to drive that part of the trip.

b. I looked around nervously the entire time I was in the dark parking garage.

9. optional adj., not compulsory or automatic

a. Check this box if you wish to have this optional insurance.

b. Having a driver's license is not optional.

10. tempt v., to be inviting or attractive to

a. I am tempted by the idea of driving across the country instead of flying.

b. Gina is tempted to rent the smaller car to save a few dollars.

11. thrill n., the source or cause of excitement or emotion

a. The thought of renting a sports car gave John a thrill.

b. Just taking a vacation is thrill enough, even if we are driving instead of flying.

12. tier n., a rank or class

a. The car rental company had a few tiers of cars, each one costing more than the previous tier.

b. If you are on a budget, I suggest you think about renting a car from our lowest tier.

Will your next trip involve a rental car? With a little careful planning, you can prevent some common headaches. If your travel plans coincide with a holiday, you need to plan well ahead of time. Car rental agencies are very busy at such times, and you won't be guaranteed a car unless you make your reservation well in advance. Contact the car rental agency and specify the kind of car you want and the dates you will need it. It's a good idea to call the agency again shortly before you begin your trip to confirm your reservation. This is the best way to avoid disappointment.

Another common problem that car renters face is extra charges. Some agencies add charges for options without letting the renter know about them. Sometimes renters aren't aware of this until they receive their credit card bill. Read the contract carefully before you sign it to make sure that you are paying only for what you requested. And don't be tempted to pay for things you don't need. It might be fun to drive a large, luxury car, but if you are traveling alone and are on a budget, it probably isn't worth paying for such a car.
